JudgeQuestion.description: A single binary acceptance question in a step's `[llmjudge]` block.

question.description: The atomic yes/no question. Must be answerable 1 (verifiably yes) or 0.

violation.description:
Optional violation example (`question :: violation example`) anchoring
what a 0 looks like.

NetworkDefault.description:
Document-level egress default for guarded steps that omit `[network]`.

Authored as a `[network-default]: allow|deny` header above the first step.
Absent ⇒ `deny`: a step-guarded prompt locks egress closed unless a step
grants hosts (or `[network]: *`). `allow` restores the legacy open behavior.

Rule.description:
A capability rule (`[allowed]` / `[disallowed]`).

A wildcard, an explicit keyword/tool-set list, or unrestricted. Matches the
markdown semantics exactly — empty is unrestricted, `*` is the wildcard,
everything else is a comma-separated list of keywords and tool-set names
expanded at check time.

oneOf.description: An explicit list of keywords and/or tool-set names.

SetDefinition.description:
A tool-set / network-set definition authored inline in the prompt.
`extend` distinguishes `[name]+:` (append) from `[name]:` (replace).

Transition.description:
A typed `[transition]`: the valid next step numbers and whether `Exit` is an
authored target (Exit is always allowed regardless, per the engine).

exit.description: Whether `Exit` appears in the authored transition list.

gates.description:
Per-target deterministic gate commands, keyed by target step. Runs only
for that target, after the step-level `[gate]`.

to.description: Numeric next steps, in authored order.

Version.description:
The IR schema version. Authored as a `[guard]: v1` header line (or the
`version` field of a `workflow.json`); missing ⇒ [`Version::V1`].

WorkflowStep.description: One compiled workflow step: the typed equivalent of a parsed [`Step`].

body.description: The authoritative prose body re-injected on transition.

max_visits.description:
Optional `max-visits` re-entry bound: the step may be entered at most
this many times before a transition into it is denied.

network.description: Network-set names granted for the step's egress policy.

transition.description: The valid transitions out of the step.

description: The canonical compiled workflow: a version tag plus the ordered steps.

network_default.description:
Document-level egress default for guarded steps without `[network]`.
Absent ⇒ deny.

rules.description:
`[rules]: <path>` imports of shared guard-rules files, in authored order,
resolved relative to the prompt file.

sets.description: Tool/network sets defined inline in the prompt (highest precedence).

steps.description: The workflow steps, ordered by step number.
